name: Leshy
description: Master spirit of the forest and protector of all wildlife. A shapeshifter who leads trespassers astray.
mythology: The Leshy is the master spirit of the forest — one of the most powerful nature spirits in Slavic belief. He can appear as a giant whose head touches the treetops, or shrink to the height of a mushroom. He may look like a local peasant but with his coat inside-out, or appear without eyebrows, eyelashes, or a right ear. He leads travelers off the path using illusions and echoes. To break his spell, turn all your clothes inside-out. Hunters must make a pact with the Leshy for good hunting luck. In autumn he goes underground to sleep; in spring he awakens again. He is the shepherd of all forest animals — wolves, bears, and deer are his flock.

offerings: Bread and salt left at forest edge
